payload.description_html: This is a photo of a Blue-capped Rock Thrush (male) sitting on a small branch in Tamhini Ghat, Western Ghats, Maharashtra, India. It has a bright blue head and orange belly. This bird visits Western Ghats in summer and loves hilly forests like Tamhini.
